name: bustrack-monorepo
description: Sistema completo de rastreio de ônibus em tempo real

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-user && npm install && cd ../frontend-admin && npm install && cd ../frontend-driver && npm install && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:driver"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && npm run build:driver
